title: Design: how a free-text reply is graded by meaning, Italian and English
goal: A recorded choice of grading method for the bilingual pack
acceptance: docs/work/records/B-006.md records, for the four bilingual-it-en cases, how the `reply` text is graded without exact wording: the existing `rubric-v1` (language, required words, forbidden words) or the planned json-match of F-032 (ignored and per-path rules) for `reply`, with `intent` and `language` still exact; a model judge is rejected unless a rubric cannot separate a correct reply from a wrong one, and the reason is recorded
Italian and English accepted paraphrases and wrong-meaning replies are listed for each case (for example `La riunione è stata spostata a martedì.` accepted, a reply naming Monday only refused)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; no private reports or consumer data.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Design recorded in docs/PROTOCOL.md ("JSON reply with a free-text field") and the B-006 record: a deterministic rubric per case, new kind json-rubric; model judge rejected (four cases with checkable facts). Not a measurement.
